name: FloorGen
description: Draw, edit, check and render 2D/3D floor plans: walls, rooms, doors, windows, furniture and stairs, with building-code checks and PDF, DXF and glTF export; changes show live in the FloorGen editor. OAuth sign-in with a free FloorGen account. Endpoint: `https://floorgen.app/mcp` · [Website](https://floorgen.app)
